# Flawless Dance & Fitness Studio (FDFS) — Navi Mumbai Knowledge Base

> Premier dance academy, cardio fitness centre, and choreography studio in Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai. Operating two specialized studio campuses (Sector 16 Main Flagship and Sector 5 Station Campus). Founded and directed by reality TV choreographer Avinash Mishra with Senior Faculty & National Hip Hop Gold Medalist Ankit Gupta.

## Canonical Studio Identity & Contacts
- Brand Name: Flawless Dance & Fitness Studio (FDFS)
- Official Domain: https://flawlessdance.in

- Operating Hours: Monday to Sunday: 07:00 AM – 10:30 PM IST (365 days)
- Campuses:
  - Flagship Campus (Sector 16): 1st Floor, Krishna Vihar, Opp. Bus Stop, Sector 16, Talvali, Ghansoli Gaon, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400701. (Phone: +91 88501 20018)
  - Station Campus (Sector 5): Plot No. 64, Tilak School Road, Opp. Tilak International School, Sector 5, Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400701. (Phone: +91 98922 26202)

## Local Ranking & Service Areas
- Core Hub: Ghansoli (Sector 1 to Sector 21, Talvali, Ghansoli Gaon)
- Adjacent Service Zones: Kopar Khairane, Airoli, Mahape (Millennium Business Park), Rabale, Vashi, Turbhe, Digha, Navi Mumbai.

## Core Disciplines & Batches
1. Zumba & Cardio Fitness: High-energy weight-loss and endurance dance conditioning (Morning 07:00-09:00 AM & Evening 07:00-09:00 PM).
2. Bollywood Commercial & Folk: Step-by-step Bollywood hit tracks and festive routines for all ages.
3. Hip Hop, Popping & Street: Urban isolation, popping grooves, locking, krump foundation taught by Indian Hip Hop gold medalist Ankit Gupta.
4. Kids Dance Academy (Ages 4–12): Structured motor-skill, posture, confidence, and stage performance training.
5. Ladies-Only Batches: Private daytime batches (11:00 AM - 12:00 PM and 04:00 PM - 05:00 PM).
6. Wedding & Sangeet Choreography: Bespoke couple routines, bride/groom entries, and family group sangeet sequences.
7. Yoga & Mindful Conditioning: Flexibility, core stability, and breathing techniques.

## Fee Structure & Non-Refundable Policy
- Fixed pricing is deliberately not published online because tuition is tailored to individual age groups, training frequency (2-day, 3-day, or daily unlimited), and skill tier.
- Transparent consultation and complimentary trial sessions are scheduled via WhatsApp or the website booking terminal.
- Strict Policy: Fees once paid to Flawless Dance & Fitness Studio are 100% non-refundable and non-transferable under all circumstances.
